rv.q: In short, this is a solo performance of immense appeal. If you have the chance to see it, take it.
Rebecca Vaughan shines a light on an obscure work by one of the most read of authors.

cn.t: Dyad Productions' adaptation of Austen's novella earns praise for its vivid storytelling and sharp wit, with critics finding it a captivating solo performance that brings the lesser-known work to life through minimal staging.
